abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
_curatorNotes: [A7] In-mode Normal/Charged Attacks deal Geo DMG that other infusions cannot override (kit detail; trimmed from the user caveat for length).

abilities.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: Phase Shift Radiance and the enhanced Skill it powers, Spirit Steed's Stride — DEF-scaling Geo hits whose 2nd is a Lunar-Crystallize reaction. These are on-field damage with no frame data, so only the mode window is shown.
_curatorNotes: Modeled as behavior:"stance" (Lunar Phase Shift mode): 15s window (sidecar 'Lunar Phase Shift Duration' col 10 = 15.0s), ends on swap-off (terminatesOnSwap:true, KQM: mode lasts '15s, until all Skill charges are consumed, or until she swaps off-field'). CD 18s (sidecar 'CD' col 10 = 18.0s).

durationExtensions: burst cast while in-stance extends the current mode by +1.7s (kit text: 'if Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift, the duration ... will extend by an additional 1.7s'). This replaces the genshin-db stub's spurious burst duration:1.7.
Removed the genshin-db stub's spurious tags:["summon"] — Lunar Phase Shift is a self stance/mode, not a summoned entity.

NOT MODELED (personal on-field DPS, no gcsim source / frameless): Phase Shift Radiance economy (KQM: +10/s passive, +5 per Normal hit on a 0.5s ICD; C1 +100 on Skill cast and 5 charges; C6 +50% gain rate), and Spirit Steed's Stride enhanced Skill (needs >=70 Radiance; two DEF-scaling Geo hits, 2nd is Lunar-Crystallize; sidecar 'Spirit Steed's Stride 1/2-Hit DMG' col 10 = 310.6% / 253.7% DEF). Particle gen: 2/3 chance of 1 particle per hit in mode, 2s ICD (KQM). Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam — in mode the 4th Normal adds a Lunar-Crystallize instance (sidecar 'Lunar Phase Shift 4-Hit Additional DMG' col 10 = 53.0% DEF). None of these are team-facing; all require radiance simulation the planner does not do.
[A7] In-mode Geo conversion of Normal/Charged Attacks is retained on the Normal-attack caveat; dropped here to avoid duplication.
abilities.description:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special Phase Shift Radiance through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of Geo DMG, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

abilities.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence
abilities.caveat: The two DEF-scaling Geo hits — the 2nd a Lunar-Crystallize reaction — have no frame data, so they are not shown.
_curatorNotes: Two DEF-scaling Geo hits, 2nd considered Lunar-Crystallize reaction DMG (sidecar 'Skill 1/2-Hit DMG' col 10 = 228.5% / 319.9% DEF). Damage hits not authored — frameless, personal on-field DPS.

Removed the genshin-db stub's duration:1.7 — that value is the Lunar Phase Shift extension the Burst grants, not the Burst's own window. Modeled as a durationExtension on the Skill's stance instead. CD 15s (sidecar col 10 = 15.0s), Energy 60 (sidecar col 10 = 60).
abilities.description:
Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of Geo DMG, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
When cast, if Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift**, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.

passives.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends
_curatorNotes: NOT MODELED as an effect: this is a self additive-Base-DMG bonus to a single hit of an unmodeled DEF-scaling ability (Spirit Steed's Stride 2nd hit +60% of Zibai's DEF for 4s), triggered by Skill cast or by a nearby Moondrift Harmony (Lunar reaction). No clean primitive for 'additive base DMG to a specific in-mode hit', and the hit itself is frameless personal DPS. C2 enhances this to a further +550% DEF (see the C2 node). The removed genshin-db stub modeled it as a standalone target:enemy damage effect, which mis-signals a separate damage instance.
passives.description: When casting the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the Selenic Descent effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of **Spirit Steed's Stride** is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.

passives.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
passives.caveat: These self buffs scale with your team: +15% DEF per other Geo ally (cap +45%) and +60 EM per Hydro ally (cap +180). Shown as a per-ally rate — multiply by the number of qualifying allies.
_curatorNotes: Self buff conditioned on team composition — NOT a buff Zibai gives the team. The genshin-db stub had this backwards (target:team, +60 EM to the party); corrected to two self buffs. Values are per-qualifying-member (fixed constants from kit text, no per-count multiplier primitive), so authored at the single-member amount with a caveat noting it scales per member. teamElementCount counts non-holder members, so Zibai's own Geo is correctly excluded.
passives.description: Other Geo party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. Hydro party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.

constellations.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
_curatorNotes: NOT MODELED (personal on-field DPS, frameless): on Skill cast, +100 Phase Shift Radiance and max Spirit Steed's Stride charges 4→5; each mode entry, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize DMG +220%. All tied to the unmodeled radiance economy and DEF-scaling in-mode hits.
constellations.description:
After using the Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest**, Zibai will immediately gain 100 **Phase Shift Radiance**, and the max number of Spirit Steed's Stride usages per Lunar Phase Shift mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.

constellations.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
constellations.caveat: Shown as a fixed 15s team window, but in game it lasts only while she is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode — it ends early if she swaps off-field.
_curatorNotes: Team buff authored: +30% Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG to all nearby party members while Zibai is in Lunar Phase Shift mode. Triggered on Skill cast (opens the stance), duration = mode window (15s), gated on state:inStance for the mode caveat.

NOT MODELED (personal on-field DPS, frameless): the Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam half of C2 enhances A1 'The Selenic Adeptus Descends' — Spirit Steed's Stride 2nd hit gains a further +550% of Zibai's DEF (additive base DMG to an unmodeled DEF-scaling hit).
constellations.description:
When in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Ascension Talent **The Selenic Adeptus Descends** is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."

constellations.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill **Heaven and Earth Made Manifest** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
_curatorNotes: NOT MODELED (personal on-field DPS, frameless): in mode, Normal Attack sequence no longer resets; on Spirit Steed's Stride hit, Zibai gains 'Scattermoon Splendor' so the next Normal combo's 4th-hit additional attack deals 250% of its original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG. Tied to the unmodeled in-mode combo.
constellations.description: While in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when Spirit Steed's Stride hits opponents, Zibai will gain the "Scattermoon Splendor" effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

constellations.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Tri-Sphere Eminence** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
_curatorNotes: NOT MODELED (self-only, radiance-dependent, frameless): in mode, Phase Shift Radiance gain rate +50%; Spirit Steed's Stride consumes ALL Radiance and elevates that instance's DMG and Zibai's own Lunar-Crystallize DMG for 3s by 1.6% per point consumed above 70 (non-stacking). This is an 'elevate' on lunarCrystallize but self-only and scaled by consumed radiance the planner cannot simulate, so no elevate effect is authored.
constellations.description:
While Zibai is in the **Lunar Phase Shift** mode, her Phase Shift Radiance gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, Spirit Steed's Stride will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will **elevate** the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.
